items.title: NASA discovers Jupiter’s invisible shield is more complex than Earth’s
items.snippet: NASA’s Juno spacecraft has discovered that Jupiter uses a surprisingly complex system of powerful plasma waves and multiple shock regions to defend against the solar wind. items.title: 128,000-year-old ice in Tibet could rewrite climate history
